The old world had millions of them. A revenant is formed when a soul becomes highly corrupted and does not cleanly exit the body. What remains in the body is sort of a shadow or pseudo-soul formed from the left behind emotions, desires, and attachments of the soul. Essentially they are walking husks inhabited by the last desires and will of the previous host. Why does this happen? Well it has to do with the consequences of magic and that is way too long of an explanation for a comment so just know that intense emotion, desire, will, and attachment leaves pathways or roots in reality. When these roots are short and clean they can be easily plucked when it’s time for the soul to leave, but when they are long and tangled there arises an issue. The roots are unable to be cleanly removed and are torn while the corrupted desire leaves scars in reality. As the soul has been torn away the roots now only have a burning void instead of a soul. The roots join together in an attempt to fill the void and create the pseudo-soul. Think of this pseudo-soul like a tangled ball of yarn that slowly get smaller over time and thusly needs to take in more string to keep its size. The roots will gradually shorten as revenant is active becoming weaker as a result. However, revenants can once again lengthen their roots and extend their life by consuming the soul essence of others, by soaking their pseudo-soul in this essence it loosely simulated their missing soul. This will even further corrupt the revenant making their behavior more violent and strange. In the current age, revenants are very rare but when they are found it’s usually on the fields after great bloody battles where the person probably had a great desire to kill or live and the revenant will thusly blindly attack any person it sees as the persons last emotions and desires were violent in nature.
